name: SaaSHunt

conditions: Submission exists but the visible economy is paid — 'Launch from $10' tiers, 'Outbid' auctions for top-8 slots, Featured Premium Plus placements; a free/basic submit path likely exists behind 'Submit Project' but paid placement dominates
requirements: 'Submit Project' flow; launch tiers from $10; Outbid lets you buy the daily top-8 slots ($16-$35 observed)
Badge + backlink marketing — 'Earn a Badge & High DR Backlink'
preparation: Project name, tagline, description, categories, logo
Budget for launch tier/outbid if free visibility is insufficient
workflow: Choose launch tier (from $10) or compete via Outbid for top positions
Listing gets a product page and daily-launch placement
watchFor: Low-quality directory economics — most 'top' placements are bought; one listing observed advertising 'invisible AI for proctored exams' — questionable content vetting
Claimed backlink value is marketing copy
countsAsLive: The project has a listing page on saashunt.best
